system.description: The curse is put on a single object within range, which then significantly decreases its traits when in use. The conjured power sticks to the object like a foul and degenerate force. Any person attempting to use the object suffers a negative modifier of -2 on all Skill rolls and Situation rolls in which the object is used. If the object is a weapon, damage is also decreased by -1, and if the object is armor, Protection Value is also decreased by -1.
system.summary: Curses an object to greatly reduce its effectiveness or render it faulty.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the duration by 1 action round
Increase the power's duration by 1 hour
Increase the range by 5 meters (contact is no longer necessary)
Affect another target (which suffers the power's basic effect)
